title: Vissarion Mihailovitch Maximoff - Candidate For SMP (Foreign Branch)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COPY
REPORT
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. 421
Special Branch O. 24 March
Date January 20, 1933.

Subject (in full) Vissarion Mihailovitch Maximoff, Candidate for S.M.P.
(Foreign Branch).

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by

With reference to the memo of the D.C. (Training) dated
January 10, 1933, regarding one V.M. Maximoff, it has been
ascertained that he is a Russian, born in Vladivostok on October
11, 1911. He arrived in Shanghai from Russia in company with
his parents in 1924. His father, Mihail Condraticovitch
Maximoff, is a native of Nijni Novgorod, North Russia, born
in 1854 and is a book keeper by profession. At one time he
was a broker on a small scale. At present he is unemployed
and assists his wife in conducting a boarding-house. Maximoff's
mother, Alexandra Philipovna Maximoff, is a ladies dressmaker
by profession, and owns a small Dressmaker's Shop, in her boarding
house at 925 Harmony Terrace, Avenue Joffre Housell. She
supports the whole family. Maximoff received his education
in the First Russian School, 27 Yulin Road. He graduated in
July 1930. From 1930 till the end of 1932 when he was discharged
on account of the depression, he was employed as an engineer-
apprentice with "Callender's Cable and Construction Co. Ltd.",
Room 305, 368 Kiangse Road. From June to August 1932 he had a
spare time job as a salesman with the Melcher & Co. (Motor Sales
Department), 627 Avenue Foch. Maximoff has been a member of
the Shanghai Field Battery S.V.C. from January 1931. He
resides with his parents at 925 Avenue Joffre, House No.11,
Harmony Terrace.

There is nothing against him in Municipal Police records.

Signed: G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
Original of report forwarded to D.S. &
attached to application of Maximoff to
S.M.P. on 20/1/33.

发自 2
G. 35m-11-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
副本
报告
特别科登记处
档案号 421
特别科 O. 3月24日
日期：1933年1月20日。

主题（全称）维萨里昂·米哈伊洛维奇·马克西莫夫（Vissarion Mihailovitch Maximoff），上海公共租界工部局警务处（外籍队）候选人。

制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）。转发人

关于副总监（训练）于1933年1月10日发出的有关 V.M. 马克西莫夫的备忘录，经查证，他系俄罗斯人，1911年10月11日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克。他于1924年随父母从俄罗斯抵达上海。其父米哈伊尔·孔德拉季耶维奇·马克西莫夫（Mihail Condraticovitch Maximoff）系俄罗斯北部下诺夫哥罗德人，生于1854年，职业为簿记员。他曾一度从事小规模经纪业务。目前失业，协助妻子经营一家寄宿公寓。马克西莫夫之母亚历山德拉·菲利波芙娜·马克西莫娃（Alexandra Philipovna Maximoff）职业为女装裁缝，在其位于霞飞路豪塞尔公寓和谐里925号的寄宿公寓内拥有一家小型女装裁缝店。她供养全家。马克西莫夫就读于玉林路27号第一俄罗斯学校。他于1930年7月毕业。从1930年至1932年底因经济萧条被解雇期间，他受雇于江西路368号305室的“卡伦德电缆与建筑有限公司”（Callender's Cable and Construction Co. Ltd.），担任工程师学徒。1932年6月至8月，他在霞飞路627号梅尔彻公司（Melcher & Co.）（汽车销售部）兼职担任销售员。自1931年1月起，马克西莫夫一直是上海野战炮兵志愿后备队（Shanghai Field Battery S.V.C.）的成员。他与父母同住于霞飞路和谐里11号925室。

在工部局警务处档案中，没有任何不利于他的记录。

签名：G. 切列姆尚斯基
副总监
特别科主管警官。
报告原件已转发给副总监，并附于马克西莫夫于1933年1月20日提交给上海公共租界工部局警务处的申请书中。
